title: Battlemaster Rhorious
summary: Rhorious calls his lieutenants and groundpounders into the fight as his health drops.
overview: Rhorious calls his lieutenants and groundpounders into the fight as his health drops.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: At 75%, prepare to collect the named lieutenants.
At 50%, prepare for the groundpounders to join.
Defeat the battlemaster and all required supporting enemies to complete the event.
Keep the event engaged so its recovery and reset timers do not undo progress.
